prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Can you help me find a sweet white wine with spice flavors and a creamy feel for a picnic, for under 15 euros?"

List A:
Wine 1: Sauvignon Blanc, US, $15. Tasting note: "This is an innocuous, flowery and lemony white wine priced to sell that offers a creamy texture amid a light body and soul. For picnics and larger gatherings, it'll represent well."
Wine 2: Riesling, US, $9. Tasting note: "If you like your white wines fruity and sweet, this one's for you. It has pretty flavors of peaches, honey and spices."
Wine 3: Moscato, Italy, $15. Tasting note: "Here's a fun, simple dessert wine that opens with scents of sage and citrus. The aromas carry over to the frothy palate along with lime and apricot. This would be ideal to accompany brunch or summer picnics."
Wine 4: Pinot Grigio, US, $10. Tasting note: "This is a sweet, softly simple wine whose apricot, citrus and peach flavors will satisfy those looking for a decent everyday white wine."
Wine 5: Nebbiolo, Italy, $30. Tasting note: "Here's a simple, easygoing wine that offers fleshy black cherry, clove, cinnamon and accents of white pepper. It's extremely accessible, with soft acidity and fleeting tannins. Enjoy through 2015."

List B:
Wine 1: White Blend, US, $10. Tasting note: "A nice white wine to drink on a warm afternoon, at a picnic. It's definitely on the sweet side, but nice and crisp, with orange and pineapple flavors."
Wine 2: Riesling, US, $9. Tasting note: "If you like your white wines fruity and sweet, this one's for you. It has pretty flavors of peaches, honey and spices."
Wine 3: Zinfandel, US, $10. Tasting note: "Good price for a dry summer blush wine for drinking with barbecue, sandwiches or just about anything easy. With berry and spice flavors, it has a nice bite of acidity."
Wine 4: Mourvèdre, US, $50. Tasting note: "This unique wine offers light aromas of white pepper, bay leaf, coffee and dried leaves. The cherry flavors are elegant with a creamy feel and a tart finish, seeming a big compact at present but developing over time."
Wine 5: Fiano, US, $26. Tasting note: "This is an interesting, dry white wine from an unusual grape variety. It's more savory than fruity, as the aromas resemble white and black pepper, while flavors are subtle and figgy. The texture is quite rich and the finish lingers nicely. It's very full-bodied for a white, and definitely worth a try."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
